title: ue, ew, ui
goal: Read and spell the vowel teams **ue**, **ew**, and **ui**, which usually say /o͞o/ (as in "moon") and sometimes /ū/ (as in "cute").

dictation: I will buy a new blue bag

A.text: Sam and his mom go to buy a new bike. / "I want the blue one," said Sam. / The shop has a big, blue bike that is true to what Sam likes. / Sam's mom said, "Let's buy it, then get a snack." / They get a bag of fruit and chew on it as they walk home with the new bike.

B.text: Because she had a big meeting, Kate had to buy a new suit. / She went to a shop and got a blue suit that fit true to size. / "This one is right for you," said the person at the shop. / Kate said, "That is true, I will buy this one." / She got a snack of fruit on her way home, glad to have a new suit for the big day.
